title: Scp-087 The Stairwell
style: 1990s handheld camcorder VHS home video freeze frame shot at night in a dark house, lit only by the small camcorder light, low resolution, tracking distortion, washed-out colours, blown highlights, tape smear, deep black shadows, photorealistic, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no watermarks, vertical composition

credit.author: Zaeyde
credit.line: Based on SCP-087 by Zaeyde - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-087 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: A staircase that never ends, and someone crying at the bottom. Would you walk down?

Hero.look: short dark hair, dark Foundation jacket, seen only from behind, no face

scenes.image_prompt: a very dark concrete stairwell seen from a landing, a black iron balustrade and handrail spiralling down into a pure black void in the middle of the frame, a few pale steps fading away, one cold light on the wall, the drop below completely black, black and white, monochrome, high contrast, 90s camcorder footage, VHS grain {style}

lines.text: This report was never meant to leave the archive. It describes a janitorial closet door hiding an unlit staircase that descends deeper than the building allows.

scenes.label: INCIDENT 1
scenes.image_prompt: a long steep flight of concrete stairs going down and down, the steps getting dimmer and dimmer until they vanish into absolute darkness, a metal handrail on the wall, no end visible, black and white, monochrome, high contrast, 90s camcorder footage, VHS grain {style}

lines.text: In the first exploration, a test subject took a light down thirteen steps to a round platform, where the stairs turned and kept going, while far below a child cried.

scenes.label: THE FACE
scenes.image_prompt: the edge of a dark stair landing looking down a black stairwell shaft, flights of stairs below disappearing into the void, far below in the blackness a faint pale smear, no clear shape, black and white, monochrome, high contrast, 90s camcorder footage, VHS grain {style}

lines.text: It sounded two hundred meters away, yet no one got closer. Each explorer met a face with no pupils, no nostrils, no mouth.

scenes.label: THE RESPONSE
scenes.image_prompt: a plain grey steel closet door in a bright ordinary university corridor, thick foam padding visible at the edge, one fluorescent light, dark corner shadow, black and white, monochrome, high contrast, 90s camcorder footage, VHS grain {style}

lines.text: So the Foundation sealed the door in steel, with padding six centimeters thick.

scenes.label: PROCEDURE
scenes.image_prompt: a single bare dim bulb above a dark stairwell, steps descending under it, the light dying a few steps down into total blackness, nothing else visible, black and white, monochrome, high contrast, 90s camcorder footage, VHS grain {style}

lines.text: Now no one enters, because any light brighter than seventy-five watts is simply swallowed.

scenes.label: NOT IN THE REPORT
scenes.image_prompt: 90s camcorder footage, padded steel door seen from far down a corridor, one flickering ceiling light, a pale grey blurred face hidden in shadow beneath the door's edge, tracking lines {style}

lines.text: What I keep skipping is the fourth exploration, the longest: data expunged, then knocking from inside the door.

scenes.label: THE LAST ENTRY
scenes.image_prompt: the flashlight beam on the last few steps, beyond them endless stairs dropping away into pitch black, far down in the dark a very faint pale smear, no clear face, 90s camcorder footage, VHS static {style}

lines.text: The last entry says the knocking has ceased. I never wrote that, and you heard it too.

scenes.image_prompt: 90s camcorder freeze-frame, pale grey blurred face very close in darkness, shut heavy-lidded eyes, no pupils, faint closed mouth, soft vignette, lit by one dim light, out of focus, tracking lines {style}
